synopsis: Teams of elite pitmasters compete in a non-stop, week-long endurance battle over live fire to win their share of over $50,000. Hosts and judges Andrew Zimmern, Jess Pryles, Moe Cason, and Ernest Servantes crown one team the Pitmasters Champion.

episodes.title: Meat Your Competition
episodes.synopsis: Hosts and judges Andrew Zimmern, Ernest Servantes, Jess Pryles, and Moe Cason kick off the competition by giving the teams nine hours to create a family-style barbecue platter that defines their barbecue style and culinary point of view.

episodes.title: Trifecta of Live Fire
episodes.synopsis: The teams create a BBQ platter that defines their culinary point of view.

episodes.title: Sink or Swim
episodes.synopsis: The teams are faced with a meatless challenge, and the winner has a big choice to make

episodes.title: Rooter to Tooter & Head-to-Head
episodes.synopsis: The six remaining teams face off in a nose-to-tail barbecue battle, transforming either a hog, goat, or lamb into two main dishes and two sides; with $2,000 on the line, they must use the remaining parts of their animal to make sausage.
